name: Petra & Wadi Rum
about: Spring and fall are mild and ideal, summer desert heat is intense, winter nights in Wadi Rum can be near-freezing.
overview: Petra's rose-red facades carved into canyon walls, paired with Wadi Rum's Mars-red desert a few hours south.
costOverview: Daily food and transport are inexpensive — the Petra entrance fee alone is one of the most expensive single-site tickets anywhere in the world.
monthlyWeather: cold, especially at night, with occasional rain and near-freezing desert nights
